definitions.gloss: leave of absence from school, academic leave
definitions.explanation: Temporarily suspending one's enrollment at a school or university, typically for personal, health, or financial reasons.

examples.japanese: {病気|びょうき}のため{休学|きゅうがく}した。
examples.english: I took a leave of absence from school due to illness.

examples.japanese: {休学|きゅうがく}{届|とどけ}を{出|だ}す。
examples.english: To submit a leave of absence application.

examples.japanese: 1{年間|ねんかん}{休学|きゅうがく}して{留学|りゅうがく}した。
examples.english: I took a year off from school to study abroad.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {休学|きゅうがく}する (to take a leave of absence)
- {休学|きゅうがく}{届|とどけ} (leave of absence application)
- {休学|きゅうがく}{期間|きかん} (period of leave)

RELATED TERMS:
- {復学|ふくがく} (returning to school)
- {退学|たいがく} (dropping out)
- {留年|りゅうねん} (repeating a year)
